description.narrative:
Women`s Initiatives förslag till finansiering för att genomföra kärnstöd för den Strategiska planen uppfyller kraven i tillämpliga bestämmelser. WI har uppnått betydande resultat i organiserande utveckling och implementationen av uppdraget under det förra förberedande kärnstöd, därför har ambassaden bestämt sig för att fortsätta med partnerskapet.
`Womens`s Initiatives` föreslås beviljas stöd för att fortsätta den institutionella utvecklingen, för att säkerställa att organisationen fungerar på ett transparent, effektivt och uppdragsdrivet sätt.

Women`s Initiatives proposal for funding to implement core support for the Strategic Plan fulfils the requirements in applicable provisions. WI achieved outstanding results in organizational development and implementation of its mission during previous pre core support, therefore the Embassy decided to continue this partnership. `Womens`s Initiatives` will be granted to continue institutional developments to ensure a transparent, efficient and mission driven functioning.

sector.narrative: Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

description.narrative:
During 2022-2023, a Supervisory Board was elected, this is a new practice for the organization to have an external Supervisory Board. The elected board has been assisted in the establishment phase to understand organization`s Strategic Plan, RAF, strategic budget, programs and all internal policies that have been developed, as a first step in approving the documents. This sets the stage for the gradual establishment of an active board that will play the envisioned strategic role.
Women's Initiatives worked on a large number of internal strategies, policies to guide human resource management and finance, and developed a number of manuals, policies on programmatic work. Women's Initiatives provides humanitarian assistance to refugees, this new role could continue for a while (due to war in Ukraine). During 2023, the organization contributed to the development of a humanitarian support system and procedures.
During 2024, in relation to Outreach and awareness-raising to the general public on domestic violence and human trafficking Prgramme, number of rights holders (women, girls, men, and boys), events, actions, posts on human rights increased. Collaboration with duty bearers, including local educational institutions, was successfully performed and the outreach was expanded to students. Also the Platform for Combating Violence Against Women and Girls from the left bank of Nistru, that is supported by WI, managed to get more popularity in the region. A lot of effort was put into a better coordination of activities among organizations (the secretariat of Platform is hosted by WI).
Referring to Program 2, Prevention, Protection and Assistance for Victims of Trafficking and Victims of Domestic Violence and Capacity Building for Rights Holders, the number of rights holders who received different type of services increased a lot. The organization is present in 2 more communities besides Tiraspol (Slobozia, Grigoriopol) and the indicator has been overreached several times more, even though the organization did not manage to get proper phisical offices in communities and are travelling to communities frequently.
The organization keeps on following its internal policies (even though some of them needs adjustments according to recent audit report), and invest in the development of the team accordingly to set targets in Program 3: Institutional Development of Women's Initiatives.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
